blurb: Guests can rent American-made row and pedal boats hourly to explore Golden Gate Park's lake and sights including the Blue Heron Bridge and local wildlife. The boathouse also offers dining with drinks and dishes, event spaces for work events, weddings, and parties. No reservations are required for boat rentals.
